name: Minimal State Automata
priorityEvidence: 25 PYQs extracted, tested 1987-2023. Direct extension of Finite Automata, almost entirely focused on ONE recurring question type: minimum DFA state count.

unlocks.why: Minimal-state counting for a regex-defined language directly combines both skills.
